title: Lot-Drawing Turmoil
next_chapter_hook: The Fifth Elder's gloomy gaze fixed intently on Chen Ji's departing back, his knuckles cracking as he clenched them. A larger conspiracy targeting Chen Ji was brewing.

text.content: The golden light of the Tianji Record slowly faded. Chen Ji opened his eyes, the afterglow of the foresight still lingering in the depths of his pupils. Group B, position three; the hidden compartment at the bottom of the lot-drawing tube; the talisman paper slipping from the Fifth Elder's sleeve—these fragments rapidly assembled into a complete picture in his mind. "Interesting." He murmured to himself, a meaningful smile curving at the corner of his mouth. Ling Yuan's beckoning figure in the golden light lingered in his thoughts, but whether it was a trap or an opportunity, Chen Ji needed to verify in person. He rose, tidied his gray robe of a Servant Disciple,收敛了天机录的气息到极致, restoring his cowardly, timid废物模样, and pushed open the door toward the Competition Square.

The Competition Square was crowded with people. Disciples from the three great sects gathered here, their colorful Daoist robes interweaving into a magnificent sea under the morning light. In the center of the square stood a massive jade platform, with seven Elder seats arranged upon it. Tianqing Sect's old Leader Ling Yuan sat in the main seat, his hair white as snow, his countenance kind and peaceful, like a merciful clay Buddha. To the left of the platform was the contestants' waiting area, and to the right was the observation area. Several hundred Inner and Outer Disciples whispered and discussed amongst themselves. Today's lot-drawing ceremony would determine the initial matchups of the competition. The quality of one's draw position often determined a disciple's fate.

Chen Ji lowered his head and blended into the crowd, but his gaze swept across his surroundings like a hawk's. He noticed the Fifth Elder standing beside the lot-drawing platform, checking the lot-drawing tube with a gloomy expression. In the past, such administrative work would never involve an Elder personally, yet today he appeared unusually eager. Chen Ji observed all of this and filed it away. A slight bulge appeared at the Fifth Elder's sleeve, with the edge of talisman paper faintly visible—exactly as predicted by the Tianji Record. "Seems like some people can't wait any longer." Chen Ji sneered internally, while maintaining an outwardly ignorant appearance, even deliberately shrinking backward, afraid of drawing attention.

dialogue.content: "The lot-drawing ceremony is about to begin. All disciples, please approach one by one to draw your positions." Ling Yuan's aged yet commanding voice echoed across the square. His gaze seemingly swept casually across a certain corner of the crowd, his lips carrying a faint, intangible smile. That smile was warm enough to make people feel at ease, but Chen Ji detected a strong whiff of danger—it was the composure of a hunter gazing at prey.

text.content: The crowd began to stir. Disciples approached the lot-drawing platform one by one. Chen Ji mixed into the middle of the line, moving forward at a steady pace while rapidly calculating the timing in his mind. The foresight images from the Tianji Record replayed repeatedly in his mind: the Fifth Elder would rig the draw during the third round, and he had to be at the specific position at that time, avoiding the trap while exposing the enemy's scheme before everyone's eyes. "Not yet." He silently repeated to himself. "Let the bullet fly a little longer."

choice.prompt: The moment of drawing draws near. The Fifth Elder's gaze begins searching for prey among the crowd. Chen Ji needs to decide his timing for drawing—whether to follow the normal order, or deliberately adjust his position?

choices.text: Follow the normal order, act naturally
choices.description: Follow the original drawing order without any unusual moves, letting the Fifth Elder's conspiracy trigger naturally. The risk is potentially falling right into their trap.
choices.visible_reward: Fifth Elder's conspiracy exposed, without revealing foresight ability
choices.risk_hint: If the Fifth Elder's target is clear, may fall into a passive situation

text.content: Chen Ji maintained his废物disciple's cowardly appearance, blending into the middle of the line, neither too forward nor too slow. When it was his turn to draw, he trembled up onto the platform, his hands shaking so badly he could barely grip the lot-drawing tube. His eyes darted about timidly, the perfect image of a Servant Disciple who had never seen the world. The Fifth Elder's gaze lingered on him for a moment, a flash of contempt flickering in his eyes, but he paid no further attention—as far as he was concerned, this废物wasn't worth wasting a carefully designed trap on.

Chen Ji drew a bamboo slip from the lot-drawing tube, lowered his head to look—a Group C, position seven. An ordinary position, neither within the Fifth Elder's preset trap range nor would it face particularly strong opponents. A slight smile lifted at the corner of his mouth—this was exactly the result he wanted. A废物drawing a废物position, perfectly natural, no one would suspect anything.

choices.text: Deliberately fall behind, bide your time
choices.description: Deliberately slow down, let those ahead draw first, wait for the Fifth Elder's trap to trigger before acting leisurely, turning the scheme back on them.
choices.visible_reward: Full control of the situation, obtaining leverage on the Fifth Elder
choices.risk_hint: Deliberately falling behind may attract the notice of observant people

text.content: Chen Ji deliberately slowed his pace, falling to the very back of the line. Taking advantage of the chaos, he quietly circled to the side and rear of the lot-drawing platform, perfectly positioned to observe every move of the Fifth Elder. As expected, when the third round of drawing began, a talisman paper silently slipped from the Fifth Elder's sleeve, falling soundlessly to the bottom of the lot-drawing tube. The surrounding disciples were completely unaware, but Chen Ji recorded this entire scene in his mind. "Thank you for the generous gift, Fifth Elder." He internally sneered.

choices.description: Without waiting for the Fifth Elder's conspiracy to be exposed, directly point out his cheating during the draw, catching him completely off guard.
choices.visible_reward: Shock the entire audience at once, reputation soars
choices.risk_hint: Insufficient evidence may result in counterattack

text.content: When it was Chen Ji's turn to draw, instead of his usual timid behavior, he suddenly stopped, pointing at the lot-drawing tube with a surprised expression: "Fifth Elder, why is there a talisman paper glowing inside the lot-drawing tube?" His voice wasn't loud, but it was clearly audible to disciples within ten paces. Everyone turned to look, and indeed, a faint spiritual energy fluctuation was visible at the bottom of the lot-drawing tube. The Fifth Elder's face instantly turned ashen. He never expected this废物to expose him right before everyone's eyes!

The lot-drawing ceremony continued. Astonished exclamations and sighs rose intermittently from the crowd. Chen Ji held the Group C, position seven bamboo slip and retreated to the side. Seemingly scanning the square casually, his peripheral vision remained locked on the Fifth Elder. That old man's face was now so gloomy it seemed to drip water. The talisman paper in his sleeve had been quietly retrieved, but his gaze toward Chen Ji now carried more scrutiny and viciousness. Chen Ji understood clearly: "This old dog has already remembered me. But it doesn't matter. Today, he won't dare make a scene."

Just then, a commotion arose from the other side of the square. The crowd automatically parted, creating a pathway. A muscular young man with an imposing presence strode forward. He wore Xuanwu Sect's signature black battle robe, his features carrying an incomparable arrogance. Each step he took made the ground beneath him tremble slightly. "That's Han Lie from Xuanwu Sect!" A disciple exclaimed. "I heard he's already at late Foundation Building stage, his Combat Power approaching Golden Core!" Han Lie seemed deaf to the surrounding discussions. His gaze swept through the crowd like lightning, finally fixing on Chen Ji.

dialogue.content: "Oh, isn't this the famous废物Chen Ji of Tianqing Sect?" Han Lie's lips twisted into a contemptuous smirk. He strode up to Chen Ji, looking down at him from above. "I heard you got lucky at the marketplace last time, winning spirit stones from Brother Sun? Do you dare make a bet with me today? If you lose, kowtow to me three times right here; if you win, I'll give you my life!"

Chen Ji raised his head, revealing a timid smile. However, at an angle Han Lie couldn't see, a cold gleam flickered in his eyes: "Brother Han, you're too kind. I just got lucky. How could I possibly compare with Brother Han..." He deliberately paused, his voice getting softer and softer. "But... if Brother Han insists on betting, I'd like to ask—what kind of bet does Brother Han have in mind?"

choice.prompt: Han Lie presses forward relentlessly. Chen Ji appears passive but has already formulated his strategy in his heart. This is an excellent opportunity to gain fame through借势, but risks and rewards coexist—should he continue to show weakness to lure him into the trap, or appropriately reveal his edge to teach him a lesson?

choices.text: Continue showing weakness, lure him deeper
choices.description: Maintain the废物persona, let Han Lie's arrogance grow unchecked, accumulating material for future counterattack.
choices.visible_reward: Han Lie's ugliness fully exposed, becoming the laughingstock of the entire audience
choices.risk_hint: May be seen as truly cowardly

text.content: Chen Ji shrunk back, his voice barely a whisper: "Then... then how does Brother Han want to bet?" His performance was flawless—a废物whose courage had been shattered, faced with a genius's provocation, having no choice but to shiver and tremble. Upon seeing this, Han Lie grew even more complacent, sneering: "We'll bet on the draw positions! Whatever I draw, you have to draw the same thing, otherwise you lose!" At these words, whispers immediately arose among the surrounding disciples. This was clearly bullying.

choices.description: No longer purely showing weakness, use sharp words to刺 Han Lie, letting him know even废物can bite.
choices.visible_reward: Han Lie loses face completely, Chen Ji's reputation soars

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly raised his head, his eyes no longer darting about. Instead, a meaningful smile curved at the corner of his mouth: "Brother Han's bet is quite novel, but I have one thing I don't understand—does Brother Han think I'm easy to bully, or does Brother Han think Tianqing Sect has no one?" The entire audience erupted in shocked murmurs. Han Lie's expression changed instantly. He never expected this废物to dare confront him directly. He laughed in rage: "Good! Good! Good! If I don't teach you the error of your ways today, I'll write my name backwards!"

Han Lie's roar drew even more spectators. The Fifth Elder also frowned and walked over quickly. Han Lie was oblivious, already clouded by rage. He pointed at Chen Ji and cursed: "You useless thing, can't even look at yourself! Someone of your caliber dares stand before me? Today, in the competition, I'll make sure you die without a burial place!" His voice resounded across the entire square. The surrounding disciples either gloated or showed pity on their faces, but no one dared speak up to stop him. Chen Ji watched him rant calmly, his mind rapidly calculating: "Almost there. Time to close the net."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly revealed a shy smile. His voice was soft yet clearly reached everyone's ears: "Brother Han's criticism is well taken. But I dare ask one thing—Brother Han just said if you lose, you'd give me your life. Is that still valid?" Han Lie froze, then burst into wild laughter: "Valid! Of course valid! Young Master speaks with honor, never goes back on his word!" He never considered the possibility of losing. To him, betting his life against a废物was insulting. Chen Ji nodded, then turned to the Fifth Elder. "Fifth Elder, you heard all that, right?"

text.content: The Fifth Elder's face was gloomy, but he had no reason to obstruct a disciple's bet. He coldly swept his gaze over Chen Ji and said deeply: "Since it's voluntary on both sides, I shall be pleased to witness it. However, the bet is the bet, the draw proceeds by the rules." With that, he glanced meaningfully at Han Lie. "Nephew Han, if you lose, don't try to welch." Han Lie said proudly: "Young Master never welches! But if this废物loses, I want him to sever his own meridians publicly and滚出 Tianqing Sect!" The surrounding crowd gasped. The stakes were too cruel.

choice.prompt: The bet is made. Han Lie is determined to win. Yet Chen Ji already knows everything—the Tianji Record's foresight tells him all. He needs to decide how to conclude: expose Han Lie's arrogance before the draw, or let him make a complete fool of himself before everyone's eyes?

choices.description: Say no more, let Han Lie draw himself, use facts to slap his face.
choices.visible_reward: Han Lie loses face completely, Chen Ji's reputation soars
choices.risk_hint: Some may think Chen Ji got lucky

text.content: Chen Ji merely smiled faintly, saying nothing more. The draw continued. When Han Lie stepped onto the platform, he arrogantly reached into the lot-drawing tube. "I'll draw this one!" He randomly grabbed a bamboo slip, opened his palm—Group A, position one. The entire audience erupted in shock. This was the biggest draw of the day, meaning he would face a seeded player in the first round. But this wasn't the most ironic part—when Chen Ji drew next and opened his palm: Group A, position one. The two positions were identical.

choices.text: One final push, add fuel to the fire
choices.description: Before Han Lie draws, provoke him one last time, maxing out his anger before the public humiliation.
choices.visible_cost: May be seen through as deliberate
choices.visible_reward: Han Lie's anger gauge maxes out, the humiliation effect doubles

text.content: Chen Ji timidly stepped backward, muttering softly: "Brother Han is magnificent and formidable, I can't compare... but Brother Han, are you sure you want to draw? If you happen to get a bad position, I couldn't bear the responsibility." These words seemed like showing weakness but were actually adding fuel to the fire. Han Lie predictably exploded in rage: "Bullshit! Whatever Young Master draws is the best possible draw!" He slapped away other disciples and rushed straight to the lot-drawing platform, randomly grabbing a bamboo slip—Group A, position one. And when Chen Ji drew afterward, it was exactly the same position.

The entire square fell into deathly silence, then erupted into earth-shaking discussions. "How is this possible? Two Group A, position ones?" "This is too coincidental!" "Heaven's will! This is heaven's will!" Han Lie stood frozen, his face alternating between green and white. He never imagined that the casual bet he proposed would actually come true. His position was identical to Chen Ji's. According to the bet, he had already lost. But for him to give his life to a废物in public? Absolutely not!

dialogue.content: Han Lie gritted his teeth tightly, veins standing out on his face, his eyes filled with fury and不甘. He scanned his surroundings, trying to find an excuse to escape, but found everyone's gaze focused on him, awaiting his decision. The Fifth Elder stood with a gloomy face but didn't speak to help him—before so many eyes, any favoritism would only draw fire. Han Lie took a deep breath, about to make some excuse, when Chen Ji抢先一步, speaking timidly: "Brother Han, you... you wouldn't go back on your word, would you?"

text.content: This seemingly harmless sentence was like a blade, stabbing directly into Han Lie's heart. Immediately, calls rose from all around: "Brother Han is Xuanwu Sect's number one genius, of course he keeps his word!" "That's right, a real man honors his word!" Han Lie found himself in an impossible situation, his face flushed to the color of pork liver. Chen Ji watched him struggle calmly, his heart like still water. The foresight images from the Tianji Record were materializing one by one, and Han Lie was merely another piece being manipulated on his chessboard.

dialogue.content: Han Lie waved his hand violently, gritting his teeth: "Today you got lucky! In the competition, Young Master will personally tear you to pieces! By then, don't expect anyone to save you!" With that, he turned and left, as狼狈 as a stray dog. The surrounding disciples parted to let him pass, while casting complex glances toward Chen Ji—this废物, it seemed, was not as simple as he appeared on the surface. Chen Ji lowered his head, a slight upward curve at the corner of his mouth. He knew that from this day forward, the name "废物 Chen Ji" would resound through the three great sects in an unprecedented way.

text.content: The lot-drawing ceremony entered its final phase. The matchup situation for each group gradually became clear. As Chen Ji was about to leave, the Fifth Elder quietly approached him, lowering his voice: "Chen Ji, I remember what happened today." Chen Ji raised his head, his eyes full of fear and confusion: "Fi... Fifth Elder, I don't understand what you're saying..." His performance was textbook-perfect, the image of a complete pitiful wretch. The Fifth Elder snorted coldly and swept away in his robes. Chen Ji watched his retreating figure, thinking internally: "Old thing, the things I've recorded against you are far more than just today's events."
